test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can substitute/replace the bracketed word correctly and complete the sentence.

I said I (don’t) understand.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. didn't.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase** "I said I didn't understand" **correctly uses the past tense to match the past tense verb "said" in the sentence.
 
• The other options do not fit the context:
 
 
• **"Doesn't"** is present tense and does not match the past tense "said."
 
• **"Am doing"** is present continuous and does not relate to understanding.
 
• **"Done" **is past participle and incorrect in this context.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
